root_cause_analysis.problem_statement: Full pipeline cannot execute end-to-end because STT receives synthetic tones and returns empty text

root_causes.evidence: synthesizer.py checks Python version and disables Coqui and pyttsx3

root_causes.cause: Fallback TTS generates synthetic tones, not speech
root_causes.evidence: Fallback synthesizer generates pure sine waves: audio = 0.2 * np.sin(...)
root_causes.impact: Whisper STT is trained on human speech, not synthetic tones

root_causes.evidence: Diagnostic confirmed STT correctly processes float32 audio but cannot recognize sine waves as speech
root_causes.behavior: Returns empty transcript (which is correct for non-speech audio)

root_cause_analysis.escalation_path: Python 3.13+ → Coqui/pyttsx3 unavailable → Fallback TTS → Synthetic tones → STT cannot recognize → Empty transcript → Broken pipeline
